title: Register with Nevada Employee Savings Trust (NEST) or certify a retirement plan exemption
authority: Nevada Employee Savings Trust (Nevada State Treasurer)
description: Employers with six or more employees in business at least 36 months and no qualified plan must register or certify an exemption; the deadline was September 1, 2025. No penalty schedule had been published in the sources found.

appliesWhen.description: 6 or more employees in the state

exemptions: Employers that sponsor a qualified retirement plan (they still certify the exemption)
